paragraphs: Mailganer is an email marketing platform built on Django, PostgreSQL, Celery, Redis and Nginx, with a heavy vanilla JS and AJAX frontend. Joined as an intern in May 2025 — first commit to production on day five. Task count grew from a dozen a month by summer to over thirty by spring 2026.

Memorable milestones: seven SPF hotfixes in two days on live data; a compliance form due in three days — shipped in two; three critical bugs in a single day — all closed the same day; an SMTP failure found and fixed within twenty-four hours. A bulk SPF parser running five parallel threads cut domain list processing from eight hours to forty minutes.

Security ran alongside everything else: XSS through sanitize-bypass and through mark_safe on user-controlled input, an unsafe HTTP method with side effects, a full frontend audit across ten-plus apps with a risk-classified CSV report. Several vulnerabilities caught on my own initiative, outside the assigned task. Performance: search sped up 8–10x after locating the bottleneck with a profiler on a prod replica.

The longest thread — external editor integration: a year-long arc from an iframe / CORS / postMessage prototype to a proxy architecture with runtime XHR and fetch interception, substituting domains without touching a single line of third-party code. By June 2026 — Junior Developer, code reviewer, and lead developer on an internal AI/RAG project.
